translations.literal: Comprehensive Mirror in Aid of Governance, Volume 225, Scroll Volume Two Hundred Twenty-Fifth
translations.idiomatic: Comprehensive Mirror in Aid of Governance, Volume 225

sentences.zh: 【唐紀四十一】 起閼逢攝提格，盡屠維協洽七月，凡五年有奇。

translations.literal: 【Tang Records 41】 From Yefeng Shetige through the seventh month of Tuvi Xiehe—in all, about five years and a fraction.
translations.idiomatic: 【Tang Records 41】 From the first year of the Yefeng cycle through the seventh month of the last year of the Tuvi cycle—about five years in all.

sentences.zh: =代宗大曆九年=

translations.literal: =Emperor Daizong, Ninth Year of Dali=
translations.idiomatic: =The Ninth Year of Dali of Emperor Daizong=

sentences.zh: 代宗睿文孝武皇帝中之下大曆九年（

translations.literal: Mid-to-Lower of Emperor Daizong the Sage Filial Martial, Ninth Year of Dali (
translations.idiomatic: The Ninth Year of Dali of Emperor Daizong the Sage Filial Martial (mid-to-lower section) (

sentences.zh: 甲寅，公元七七四年）

translations.literal: jiayin, 774 CE)
translations.idiomatic: jiayin, 774 CE)

sentences.zh: 春，正月，壬寅，田神功薨於京師。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month, on the day renyin, Tian Shenggong died in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, in the first month, on the day renyin, Tian Shenggong died in the capital.

sentences.zh: 澧朗鎮遏使楊猷自澧州沿江而下，擅出境至鄂州，詔聽入朝。

translations.literal: Yang You, pacification commissioner of Li-Lang, descended along the river from Li Prefecture, on his own authority crossed the border to E Prefecture; an edict permitted him to come to court.
translations.idiomatic: Yang You, pacification commissioner of Li-Lang, sailed downriver from Li Prefecture, crossed the border without authorization as far as E Prefecture, and was permitted by edict to come to court.

sentences.zh: 猷遂溯漢江而上，復州、郢州皆閉城自守，山南東道節度使梁崇義發兵備之。

translations.literal: You then went up the Han River; Fu and Ying prefectures all closed their cities and held themselves; Liang Chongyi, military governor of Shannan East Circuit, dispatched troops to guard against him.
translations.idiomatic: You then went up the Han River. Fu and Ying prefectures both shut their gates and held out on their own, and Liang Chongyi, military governor of Shannan East Circuit, mobilized troops against him.

sentences.zh: 二月，辛未，徐州軍亂，刺史梁乘逾城走。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day xinwei, the Xuzhou army mutinied; the prefect Liang Cheng climbed over the wall and fled.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the day xinwei, the Xuzhou garrison mutinied, and Prefect Liang Cheng climbed over the city wall and fled.

sentences.zh: 諫議大夫吳損使吐蕃，留之累年，竟病死虜中。

translations.literal: Remonstrance Councilor Wu Sun was sent as envoy to Tibet; they detained him for many years, and in the end he died of illness among the barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: Remonstrance Councilor Wu Sun had been sent as envoy to Tibet, detained there for many years, and ultimately died of illness in foreign lands.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，汴宋兵防秋者千五百人，盜庫財潰歸，田神功薨故也。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, fifteen hundred Biansong troops on autumn frontier duty plundered the treasury and dispersed homeward—because Tian Shenggong had died.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengchen, fifteen hundred Biansong troops assigned to autumn frontier duty plundered the treasury and deserted for home, because Tian Shenggong had died.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以神功弟神玉知汴宋留後。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, Shenggong's younger brother Shenyu was made acting military governor of Biansong.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jichou, Shenggong's younger brother Shenyu was appointed acting military governor of Biansong.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，郭子儀入朝，上言：「朔方，國之北門，中間戰士耗散，什才有一。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, Guo Ziyi came to court and memorialized: "Shuofang is the northern gate of the realm; in the course of warfare the soldiers have been depleted and scattered—only one in ten remains.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guisi, Guo Ziyi came to court and memorialized: "Shuofang is the northern gate of the realm. Through years of war its fighting men have been worn down and scattered, and scarcely one in ten remains.

sentences.zh: 今吐蕃兼河、隴之地，雜羌、渾之眾，勢強十倍。

translations.literal: Now Tibet holds both the He and Long territories together with mixed Qiang and Hun forces—their power is ten times greater.
translations.idiomatic: Tibet now holds both the He and Long regions, together with mixed Qiang and Hun forces, and is ten times stronger in power.

sentences.zh: 願更於諸道各發精卒，成四、五萬人，則制勝之道必矣。」

translations.literal: I wish that each circuit would again dispatch elite troops, forming forty to fifty thousand men—then the way to victory would surely be assured."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that each circuit dispatch fresh elite troops until we have forty or fifty thousand men; then the path to victory will surely be secure."

sentences.zh: 三月，戊申，以皇女永樂公主許妻魏博節度使田承嗣之子華。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day wushen, the imperial daughter Princess Yongle was pledged in marriage to Hua, son of Weibo military governor Tian Chengsi.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the day wushen, the emperor's daughter Princess Yongle was betrothed to Hua, son of Weibo military governor Tian Chengsi.

sentences.zh: 上意欲固結其心，而承嗣益驕慢。

translations.literal: The emperor's intent was to firmly bind his loyalty, but Chengsi grew even more arrogant and insolent.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor meant to win his loyalty, but Chengsi grew only more arrogant and insolent.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以澧朗鎮遏使楊猷為洮州刺史、隴右節度兵馬使。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, Yang You, pacification commissioner of Li-Lang, was made prefect of Tao and military commander of Longyou Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuwu, Yang You, pacification commissioner of Li-Lang, was appointed prefect of Tao and military commander of Longyou Circuit.

sentences.zh: 夏，四月，甲申，郭子儀辭還邠州，復為上言邊事，至涕泗交流。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day jiashen, Guo Ziyi took leave and returned to Bin Prefecture; again he memorialized on frontier affairs, until tears streamed down.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, in the fourth month, on the day jiashen, Guo Ziyi took leave and returned to Bin Prefecture. He again memorialized on frontier affairs until tears streamed down his face.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，赦天下。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, an amnesty was proclaimed for all under heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renchen, an amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 五月，丙午，楊猷自澧州入朝。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day bingwu, Yang You came to court from Li Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the day bingwu, Yang You came to court from Li Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 涇原節度使馬璘入朝，諷將士為己表求平章事。

translations.literal: Ma Lin, military governor of Jingyuan, came to court; his officers and soldiers were prompted to submit a memorial on his behalf requesting the post of Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Lin, military governor of Jingyuan, came to court and had his officers and soldiers submit a memorial on his behalf requesting appointment as Grand Councilor.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以璘為左僕射。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, Ma Lin was made Left Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingyin, Ma Lin was appointed Left Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 六月，盧龍節度使朱泚遣弟滔奉表請入朝，且請自將步騎五千防秋；

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Zhu Ci, military governor of Lulong, sent his younger brother Tao with a memorial requesting to come to court, and also requested to lead five thousand infantry and cavalry himself for autumn frontier defense;
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Zhu Ci, military governor of Lulong, sent his younger brother Tao with a memorial asking to come to court and requesting to lead five thousand infantry and cavalry himself on autumn frontier duty;

sentences.zh: 上許之，仍為之先築大第於京師以待之。

translations.literal: The emperor granted it, and moreover had a great mansion built in advance in the capital to await him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor granted the request and had a great mansion built in advance in the capital to receive him.

sentences.zh: 癸未，興善寺胡僧不空卒，贈開府儀同三司、司空，賜爵肅國公，謚曰大辯正廣智不空三藏和尚。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, the Sogdian monk Amoghavajra of Xingshan Temple died; posthumously given Grand Preceptor of the Court and Minister of Works; enfeoffed as Duke of Su; posthumous title Grand Eloquence True Broad Wisdom Amoghavajra Tripitaka Master.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiwei, the Sogdian monk Amoghavajra of Xingshan Temple died. He was posthumously given the titles Grand Preceptor of the Court and Minister of Works, enfeoffed as Duke of Su, and granted the posthumous title Grand Eloquence True Broad Wisdom Amoghavajra Tripitaka Master.

sentences.zh: 京師旱，京兆尹黎幹作土龍祈雨，自與巫覡更舞。

translations.literal: The capital suffered drought; Jingzhao Prefect Li Gan made an earthen dragon to pray for rain, himself and shamans alternating in dance.
translations.idiomatic: The capital was stricken by drought. Jingzhao Prefect Li Gan fashioned an earthen dragon to pray for rain and danced in turn with shamans.

sentences.zh: 彌月不雨，又禱於文宣王。

translations.literal: A full month passed without rain; they prayed again at the Temple of Confucius.
translations.idiomatic: A full month passed without rain, and they prayed again at the Temple of Confucius.

sentences.zh: 上聞之，命撤土龍，減膳節用。

translations.literal: The emperor heard of it, ordered the earthen dragon removed, and reduced meals and economized expenditures.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor heard of this, he ordered the earthen dragon removed and cut back his meals and spending.

sentences.zh: 秋，七月，戊午，雨。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day wuwu, rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the seventh month, on the day wuwu, rain fell.

sentences.zh: 朱泚入朝，至蔚州，有疾，諸將請還，俟間而行。

translations.literal: Zhu Ci came to court; reaching Wei Prefecture, he fell ill; the generals requested to turn back and wait for an opportune time to proceed.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Ci came to court. When he reached Wei Prefecture he fell ill, and his generals asked to turn back and wait for a better time to continue.

sentences.zh: 泚曰：「死則輿屍而前！」

translations.literal: Ci said: "If I die, carry the corpse forward!"
translations.idiomatic: Ci said, "If I die, carry my corpse forward!"

sentences.zh: 諸將不敢復言。

translations.literal: The generals did not dare speak again.
translations.idiomatic: The generals did not dare speak again.

sentences.zh: 九月，庚子，至京師，士民觀者如堵。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day gengzi, he reached the capital; commoners and officials watching were thick as a wall.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the day gengzi, he reached the capital, and the crowds of officials and commoners who came to watch were packed like a wall.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，宴泚及將士於延英殿，犒賞之盛，近時未有。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, a banquet was held for Ci and his officers in Yanying Hall; the rewards were so lavish as had not been seen in recent times.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinchou, the court feasted Ci and his officers in Yanying Hall, with rewards so lavish as had not been seen in recent times.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，回紇擅出鴻臚寺，白晝殺人，有司擒之；

translations.literal: On the day renyin, Uighurs left Honglu Temple without permission, killed someone in broad daylight, and officials arrested them;
translations.idiomatic: On the day renyin, Uighurs left Honglu Temple without permission and killed someone in broad daylight; officials arrested them;

sentences.zh: 上釋不問。

translations.literal: The emperor released them without inquiry.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor released them without further inquiry.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，命郭子儀、李抱玉、馬璘、朱泚分統諸道防秋之兵。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, Guo Ziyi, Li Baoyu, Ma Lin, and Zhu Ci were ordered to command separately the autumn defense troops of the various circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiachen, Guo Ziyi, Li Baoyu, Ma Lin, and Zhu Ci were ordered to divide command of the various circuits' autumn frontier forces.

sentences.zh: 冬，十月，壬申，信王□薨。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the day renshen, the Prince of Xin [name missing] died.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, in the tenth month, on the day renshen, Prince of Xin Huang died.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，梁王璿薨。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, Prince of Liang Xuan died.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yihai, Prince of Liang Xuan died.

sentences.zh: 魏博節度使田承嗣誘昭義將吏使作亂。

translations.literal: Tian Chengsi, military governor of Weibo, incited Zhaoyi officers and officials to rebel.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Chengsi, military governor of Weibo, incited Zhaoyi officers and officials to rise in rebellion.

sentences.zh: =代宗大曆十年=

translations.literal: =Emperor Daizong, Tenth Year of Dali=
translations.idiomatic: =The Tenth Year of Dali of Emperor Daizong=

sentences.zh: 代宗睿文孝武皇帝中之下大曆十年（

translations.literal: Mid-to-Lower of Emperor Daizong the Sage Filial Martial, Tenth Year of Dali (
translations.idiomatic: The Tenth Year of Dali of Emperor Daizong the Sage Filial Martial (mid-to-lower section) (

sentences.zh: 乙卯，公元七七五年）

translations.literal: yimao, 775 CE)
translations.idiomatic: yimao, 775 CE)

sentences.zh: 春，正月，丁酉，昭義兵馬使裴志清逐留後薛萼，帥其眾歸承嗣。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month, on the day dingyou, Pei Zhiqing, Zhaoyi military commissioner, expelled acting governor Xue E and led his force to join Chengsi.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, in the first month, on the day dingyou, Pei Zhiqing, Zhaoyi military commissioner, drove out acting governor Xue E and led his troops over to Chengsi.

sentences.zh: 承嗣聲言救援，引兵襲相州，取之。

translations.literal: Chengsi claimed to come to the rescue, led troops to strike Xiang Prefecture, and took it.
translations.idiomatic: Chengsi claimed he was coming to the rescue, marched on Xiang Prefecture, and captured it.

sentences.zh: 崿奔洺州，上表請入朝，許之。

translations.literal: E fled to Ming Prefecture, submitted a memorial requesting to come to court, and was granted permission.
translations.idiomatic: Xue E fled to Ming Prefecture, submitted a memorial asking to come to court, and was permitted to do so.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，郭子儀入朝。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, Guo Ziyi came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinchou, Guo Ziyi came to court.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，壽王瑁薨。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, Prince of Shou Mao died.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renyin, Prince of Shou Mao died.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，朱泚表請留闕下，以弟滔知幽州、盧龍留後，許之。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, Zhu Ci memorialized requesting to remain at court and that his younger brother Tao act as Youzhou and Lulong military governor; permission was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yisi, Zhu Ci memorialized asking to remain at court and have his younger brother Tao serve as acting military governor of Youzhou and Lulong; the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 昭義裨將薛擇為相州刺史，薛雄為衛州刺史，薛堅為洺州刺史，皆薛嵩之族也。

translations.literal: Zhaoyi subordinate generals Xue Ze served as prefect of Xiang, Xue Xiong as prefect of Wei, and Xue Jian as prefect of Ming—all were of Xue Song's clan.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaoyi subordinate generals Xue Ze, Xue Xiong, and Xue Jian served as prefects of Xiang, Wei, and Ming respectively—all members of Xue Song's clan.

sentences.zh: 戊申，上命內侍孫知古如魏州諭田承嗣，使各守封疆；

translations.literal: On the day wushen, the emperor sent eunuch Sun Zhigu to Weizhou to instruct Tian Chengsi that each should keep to his own borders;
translations.idiomatic: On the day wushen, the emperor sent eunuch Sun Zhigu to Weizhou to instruct Tian Chengsi that each side should keep to its own territory;

sentences.zh: 承嗣不奉詔，癸丑，遣大將盧子期取洺州，楊光朝攻衛州。

translations.literal: Chengsi did not obey the edict; on the day guichou he dispatched the general Lu Ziqi to take Ming Prefecture and Yang Guangchao to attack Wei Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Chengsi disobeyed the edict. On the day guichou he sent the general Lu Ziqi to seize Ming Prefecture and Yang Guangchao to attack Wei Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，西川節度使崔寧奏破吐蕃數萬於西山，斬首萬級，捕虜數千人。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, Cui Ning, military governor of Xichuan, memorialized that he had defeated tens of thousands of Tibetans at the Western Mountains, beheaded ten thousand, and captured several thousand.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yimao, Cui Ning, military governor of Xichuan, reported defeating tens of thousands of Tibetans in the Western Mountains, beheading ten thousand and capturing several thousand.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔：「諸道兵有逃亡者，非承製敕，無得輒召募。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, an edict stated: "Where soldiers of the circuits have deserted, unless by imperial order none may recruit them on their own.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingchen, an edict stated: "Where soldiers of the circuits have deserted, no one may recruit them without an imperial order.

sentences.zh: 二月，乙丑，田承嗣誘衛州刺史薛雄，雄不從，使盜殺之，屠其家，盡據相、衛四州之地，自置長吏，掠其精兵良馬，悉歸魏州；

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day yichou, Tian Chengsi enticed Xue Xiong, prefect of Wei; Xiong refused; Chengsi had assassins kill him, slaughtered his family, seized all the territory of the four prefectures of Xiang and Wei, appointed his own officials, plundered elite troops and fine horses, and returned everything to Weizhou;
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the day yichou, Tian Chengsi tried to win over Wei Prefect Xue Xiong. When Xiong refused, Chengsi had him murdered by assassins, slaughtered his family, seized all four prefectures of the Xiang and Wei region, appointed his own officials, stripped them of elite troops and fine horses, and sent everything back to Weizhou;

sentences.zh: 逼孫知古與共巡磁、相二州，使其將士割耳剺面，請承嗣為帥。

translations.literal: He forced Sun Zhigu to tour Ci and Xiang with him, had his officers cut their ears and slash their faces, and petitioned that Chengsi be made commander.
translations.idiomatic: He forced Sun Zhigu to tour Ci and Xiang with him, had his officers cut off their ears and slash their faces, and petitioned that Chengsi be made their commander.

sentences.zh: 辛未，立皇子述為睦王，逾為郴王，連為恩王，遘為鄜王，迅為隨王，造為忻王，暹為韶王，運為嘉王，遇為端王，遹為循王，通為恭王，達為原王，逸為雅王。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, the imperial sons were enfeoffed: Shu as Prince of Mu, Yu as Prince of Chen, Lian as Prince of En, Gou as Prince of Fu, Xun as Prince of Sui, Zao as Prince of Xin, Xian as Prince of Shao, Yun as Prince of Jia, Yu as Prince of Duan, Yu as Prince of Xun, Tong as Prince of Gong, Da as Prince of Yuan, and Yi as Prince of Ya.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinwei, the imperial sons were enfeoffed: Shu as Prince of Mu, Yu as Prince of Chen, Lian as Prince of En, Gou as Prince of Fu, Xun as Prince of Sui, Zao as Prince of Xin, Xian as Prince of Shao, Yun as Prince of Jia, Yu as Prince of Duan, Yu as Prince of Xun, Tong as Prince of Gong, Da as Prince of Yuan, and Yi as Prince of Ya.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以華州刺史李承昭知昭義留後。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, Li Chengzhao, governor of Huazhou, was made acting military governor of Zhaoyi.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingzi, Li Chengzhao, governor of Huazhou, was appointed acting military governor of Zhaoyi.

sentences.zh: 河陽三城使常休明，苛刻少恩。

translations.literal: Chang Xiuming, commissioner of the Heyang Three Cities, was harsh and lacking in kindness.
translations.idiomatic: Chang Xiuming, commissioner of the Heyang Three Cities, was harsh and showed little kindness.

sentences.zh: 其軍士防秋者歸，休明出城勞之，防秋兵與城內兵合謀攻之，休明奔東都；

translations.literal: When his soldiers returning from autumn frontier duty came back, Xiuming went out of the city to welcome them; the frontier troops conspired with the garrison troops to attack him, and Xiuming fled to the Eastern Capital;
translations.idiomatic: When his troops returned from autumn frontier duty, Xiuming went out of the city to welcome them. The frontier soldiers conspired with the garrison troops to attack him, and Xiuming fled to the Eastern Capital;

sentences.zh: 軍士奉兵馬使王惟恭為帥，大掠，數日乃定。

translations.literal: The soldiers installed Wang Weigong, military commissioner, as commander; there was great plunder, and order was restored only after several days.
translations.idiomatic: The soldiers installed military commissioner Wang Weigong as commander. There was widespread looting, and order was restored only after several days.

sentences.zh: 上命監軍冉庭蘭慰撫之。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered the army supervisor Yan Tinglan to comfort them.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered army supervisor Yan Tinglan to pacify them.

sentences.zh: 三月，甲午朔，陝州軍亂，逐兵馬使趙令珍。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the new moon of the day jiawu, the Shanzhou army mutinied and expelled military commissioner Zhao Lingzhen.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the new moon of jiawu, the Shanzhou garrison mutinied and drove out military commissioner Zhao Lingzhen.

sentences.zh: 觀察使李國清不能禁，卑辭，遍拜將士，乃得脫去。

translations.literal: Observation commissioner Li Guoqing could not restrain them; with humble words he bowed to all the officers and soldiers, and only then was able to escape.
translations.idiomatic: Observation commissioner Li Guoqing could not restrain them. With humble words he bowed to every officer and soldier, and only then managed to escape.

sentences.zh: 軍士大掠庫物。

translations.literal: The soldiers plundered the treasury goods on a great scale.
translations.idiomatic: The soldiers looted the treasury on a large scale.

sentences.zh: 會淮西節度使李忠臣入朝，過陝，上命忠臣按之。

translations.literal: It happened that Li Zhongchen, military governor of Huai-Xi, was coming to court and passing through Shan; the emperor ordered Zhongchen to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zhongchen, military governor of Huai-Xi, happened to be coming to court and passing through Shanzhou, and the emperor ordered him to investigate.

sentences.zh: 將士畏忠臣兵威，不敢動。

translations.literal: The officers and soldiers feared Zhongchen's military might and dared not move.
translations.idiomatic: The officers and soldiers feared Zhongchen's military power and dared not stir.

sentences.zh: 忠臣設棘圍，令軍士匿名投庫物，一日，獲萬緡，盡以給其從兵為賞。

translations.literal: Zhongchen set up a thorn enclosure and had the soldiers anonymously return treasury goods; in one day ten thousand strings of cash were recovered, all given as reward to his escort troops.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongchen set up a thorn-fenced enclosure and had the soldiers anonymously return the looted goods. In one day ten thousand strings of cash were recovered, all of which he gave as rewards to his escort troops.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，薛萼、常休明皆詣闕請罪，上釋不問。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, Xue E and Chang Xiuming both came to court to seek punishment; the emperor released them without inquiry.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yisi, Xue E and Chang Xiuming both came to court to plead guilty, and the emperor released them without further inquiry.

sentences.zh: 初，成德節度使李寶臣、淄青節度使李正己，皆為田承嗣所輕。

translations.literal: Initially, Li Baochen, military governor of Chengde, and Li Zhengji, military governor of Ziqing, were both despised by Tian Chengsi.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Li Baochen, military governor of Chengde, and Li Zhengji, military governor of Ziqing, had both been held in contempt by Tian Chengsi.

sentences.zh: 寶臣弟寶正娶承嗣女，在魏州，與承嗣子維擊球，馬驚，誤觸維死；

translations.literal: Baochen's younger brother Baozheng had married Chengsi's daughter; at Weizhou, playing ball with Chengsi's son Wei, a horse startled and accidentally struck Wei dead;
translations.idiomatic: Baochen's younger brother Baozheng had married Chengsi's daughter. At Weizhou, while playing ball with Chengsi's son Wei, a horse startled and accidentally struck Wei dead;

sentences.zh: 承嗣怒，囚寶正，以告寶臣。

translations.literal: Chengsi was enraged, imprisoned Baozheng, and informed Baochen.
translations.idiomatic: Chengsi was enraged, imprisoned Baozheng, and notified Baochen.

sentences.zh: 寶臣謝教敕不謹，封杖授承嗣，使撻之；

translations.literal: Baochen apologized for lax discipline, sealed a staff and gave it to Chengsi, and had him flog Baozheng;
translations.idiomatic: Baochen apologized for failing to keep proper discipline, sealed a staff and sent it to Chengsi, and asked him to flog Baozheng;

sentences.zh: 承嗣遂杖殺寶正，由是兩鎮交惡。

translations.literal: Chengsi then beat Baozheng to death with the staff; hence mutual enmity between the two circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Chengsi then beat Baozheng to death with the staff, and from that time the two circuits became bitter enemies.

sentences.zh: 及承嗣拒命，寶臣、正己皆上表請討之，上亦欲因其隙討承嗣。

translations.literal: When Chengsi defied orders, Baochen and Zhengji both memorialized requesting to attack him; the emperor also wished to exploit the rift to attack Chengsi.
translations.idiomatic: When Chengsi defied orders, Baochen and Zhengji both memorialized asking to attack him, and the emperor also wished to exploit the breach to move against Chengsi.

sentences.zh: 夏，四月，乙未，敕貶承嗣為永州刺史，仍命河東、成德、幽州、淄青、淮西、永平、汴宋、河陽、澤潞諸道發兵前臨魏博，若承嗣尚或稽違，即令進討；

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day yimao, an edict demoted Chengsi to prefect of Yongzhou and ordered Hedong, Chengde, Youzhou, Ziqing, Huai-Xi, Yongping, Biansong, Heyang, and Zelu circuits to dispatch troops and advance on Weibo; if Chengsi still delayed, they were to advance and suppress him;
translations.idiomatic: In summer, in the fourth month, on the day yimao, an edict demoted Chengsi to prefect of Yongzhou and ordered Hedong, Chengde, Youzhou, Ziqing, Huai-Xi, Yongping, Biansong, Heyang, and Zelu to mobilize troops and advance on Weibo. If Chengsi still held back, they were to march in and suppress him;

sentences.zh: 罪止承嗣及其侄悅，自餘將士弟侄苟能自拔，一切不問。

translations.literal: Guilt was limited to Chengsi and his nephew Yue; for the rest of the officers, soldiers, younger brothers, and nephews, if they could extricate themselves, all would be forgiven.
translations.idiomatic: Guilt was limited to Chengsi and his nephew Yue. All other officers, soldiers, brothers, and nephews who could break free would be forgiven without question.

sentences.zh: 時朱滔方恭順，與寶臣及河東節度使薛兼訓攻其北，正己與淮西節度使李忠臣等攻其南。

translations.literal: At the time Zhu Tao was compliant; with Baochen and Xue Jianxun, military governor of Hedong, he attacked from the north, while Zhengji with Li Zhongchen, military governor of Huai-Xi, and others attacked from the south.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Zhu Tao was still obedient. He joined Baochen and Hedong military governor Xue Jianxun in attacking from the north, while Zhengji joined Huai-Xi military governor Li Zhongchen and others in attacking from the south.

sentences.zh: 五月，乙未，承嗣將霍榮國以磁州降。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day yimao, Chengsi's general Huo Rongguo surrendered Ci Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the day yimao, Chengsi's general Huo Rongguo surrendered Ci Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丁未，李正己攻德州，拔之。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, Li Zhengji attacked De Prefecture and captured it.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingwei, Li Zhengji attacked De Prefecture and captured it.

sentences.zh: 李忠臣統永平、河陽、懷、澤步騎四萬進攻衛州。

translations.literal: Li Zhongchen commanded forty thousand infantry and cavalry of Yongping, Heyang, Huai, and Ze and advanced to attack Wei Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zhongchen commanded forty thousand infantry and cavalry from Yongping, Heyang, Huai, and Ze and advanced against Wei Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 六月，辛未，田承嗣遣其將裴志清等攻冀州，志清以其眾降李寶臣。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day xinwei, Tian Chengsi dispatched his generals Pei Zhiqing and others to attack Ji Prefecture; Zhiqing led his force over to Li Baochen.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the day xinwei, Tian Chengsi sent his generals Pei Zhiqing and others to attack Ji Prefecture, but Zhiqing defected with his troops to Li Baochen.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，承嗣自將圍冀州，寶臣使高陽軍使張孝忠將精騎四千御之，寶臣大軍繼至；

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, Chengsi personally led troops to besiege Ji Prefecture; Baochen sent Zhang Xiaozhong, commissioner of Gaoyang Army, with four thousand elite cavalry to oppose him, and Baochen's main force followed;
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiaxu, Chengsi personally led troops to besiege Ji Prefecture. Baochen sent Gaoyang Army commissioner Zhang Xiaozhong with four thousand elite cavalry to oppose him, and Baochen's main force followed;

sentences.zh: 承嗣燒輜重而遁。

translations.literal: Chengsi burned his baggage train and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Chengsi burned his baggage train and fled.

sentences.zh: 孝忠，本奚也。

translations.literal: Xiaozhong was originally a Xi tribesman.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaozhong was originally a Xi tribesman.

sentences.zh: 田承嗣以諸道兵四合，部將多叛而懼，秋，八月，遣使奉表，請束身歸朝。

translations.literal: Tian Chengsi, because troops of the various circuits converged from four sides and many of his subordinate generals defected, grew afraid; in autumn, the eighth month, he sent envoys with a memorial requesting to surrender himself and return to court.
translations.idiomatic: With troops of the various circuits closing in from all sides and many of his subordinate generals defecting, Tian Chengsi grew afraid. In autumn, in the eighth month, he sent envoys with a memorial asking to surrender and return to court.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，郭子儀還邠州。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, Guo Ziyi returned to Bin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinsi, Guo Ziyi returned to Bin Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 子儀嘗奏除州縣官一人，不報，僚佐相謂曰：「以令公勳德，奏一屬吏而不從，何宰相之不知體！」

translations.literal: Ziyi once memorialized to appoint one county or prefecture official; there was no reply. His staff said to one another: "With the Duke's merit and virtue, to memorialize for one subordinate and not be obeyed—how lacking in propriety the chief ministers are!"
translations.idiomatic: Guo Ziyi once memorialized to appoint a county or prefecture official, but received no reply. His staff said to one another, "With the Duke's merit and standing, to memorialize for one subordinate and not be obeyed—how lacking in propriety the chief ministers are!"

sentences.zh: 子儀聞之，謂僚佐曰：「自兵興以來，方鎮武臣多跋扈，凡有所求，朝廷常委曲從之；

translations.literal: Ziyi heard of it and said to his staff: "Since the rise of warfare, military governors and martial officials have often been overbearing; whatever they requested, the court always ultimately yielded to them;
translations.idiomatic: When Guo Ziyi heard this, he told his staff, "Since warfare began, military governors and martial officials have often been overbearing, and whatever they asked for the court usually indulged;

sentences.zh: 此無他，乃疑之也。

translations.literal: There is no other reason—it was because they were distrusted.
translations.idiomatic: there was no other reason for it—they were distrusted.

sentences.zh: 今子儀所奏事，人主以其不可行而置之，是不以武臣相待而親厚之也；

translations.literal: Now in what Ziyi memorialized, the sovereign considered it unfeasible and set it aside—this is not treating him as a martial official but treating him with intimacy and favor;
translations.idiomatic: Now the sovereign has set aside what I memorialized because he judged it unfeasible. That is not treating me as a martial official to be indulged, but treating me with trust and favor;

sentences.zh: 諸君可賀矣，又何怪焉！」

translations.literal: You all may congratulate yourselves—why wonder at it!"
translations.idiomatic: you should all congratulate yourselves. Why find it strange!"

sentences.zh: 聞者皆服。

translations.literal: All who heard were convinced.
translations.idiomatic: All who heard were convinced.

sentences.zh: 己丑，田承嗣遣其將盧子期寇磁州。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, Tian Chengsi dispatched his general Lu Ziqi to raid Ci Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jichou, Tian Chengsi sent his general Lu Ziqi to raid Ci Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 九月，戊申，回紇白晝刺市人腸出，有司執之，系萬年獄；

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day wushen, a Uighur stabbed a market person in broad daylight and pulled out his intestines; officials seized him and imprisoned him in Wannian jail;
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the day wushen, a Uighur stabbed a market-goer in broad daylight and pulled out his intestines. Officials seized him and held him in Wannian jail;

sentences.zh: 其酋長赤心馳入縣獄，斫傷獄吏，劫囚而去。

translations.literal: Their chieftain Chixin rushed into the county jail, hacked and wounded the jail officers, and seized the prisoner and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Their chieftain Chixin rushed into the county jail, wounded the jail officers, seized the prisoner, and fled.

sentences.zh: 上亦不問。

translations.literal: The emperor again made no inquiry.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor again made no inquiry.

sentences.zh: 壬子，吐蕃寇臨涇，癸丑，寇隴州及普潤，大掠人畜而去；

translations.literal: On the day renzi, Tibet raided Linjing; on the day guichou, raided Long Prefecture and Purun, plundering people and livestock on a great scale before departing;
translations.idiomatic: On the day renzi, Tibet raided Linjing. On the day guichou, they raided Long Prefecture and Purun, plundering people and livestock on a large scale before withdrawing;

sentences.zh: 百官往往遣家屬出城竄匿。

translations.literal: Officials of all ranks often sent their families out of the city to flee and hide.
translations.idiomatic: Officials of all ranks often sent their families out of the city to flee and hide.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，鳳翔節度使李抱玉奏破吐蕃於義寧。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, Li Baoyu, military governor of Fengxiang, memorialized that he had defeated Tibet at Yining.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingchen, Li Baoyu, military governor of Fengxiang, reported defeating Tibet at Yining.

sentences.zh: 李寶臣、李正己會於棗強，進圍貝州，田承嗣出兵救之。

translations.literal: Li Baochen and Li Zhengji met at Zaoqiang, advanced and besieged Bei Prefecture, and Tian Chengsi dispatched troops to rescue it.
translations.idiomatic: Li Baochen and Li Zhengji met at Zaoqiang, advanced to besiege Bei Prefecture, and Tian Chengsi sent troops to the rescue.

sentences.zh: 兩軍各饗士卒，成德賞厚，平盧賞薄；

translations.literal: Both armies feasted their soldiers; Chengde's rewards were generous, Pinglu's meager;
translations.idiomatic: Both armies feasted their soldiers. Chengde's rewards were generous, Pinglu's meager;

sentences.zh: 既罷，平盧士卒有怨言，正己恐其為變，引兵退，寶臣亦退。

translations.literal: When it was over, Pinglu soldiers murmured in complaint; Zhengji feared they would mutiny, withdrew his troops, and Baochen withdrew as well.
translations.idiomatic: When the feast ended, Pinglu soldiers grumbled. Zhengji feared a mutiny and withdrew his troops, and Baochen withdrew as well.

sentences.zh: 李忠臣聞之，釋衛州，南度河，屯陽武。

translations.literal: Li Zhongchen heard of it, abandoned Wei Prefecture, crossed the river southward, and encamped at Yangwu.
translations.idiomatic: When Li Zhongchen heard of this, he abandoned Wei Prefecture, crossed the river southward, and encamped at Yangwu.

sentences.zh: 寶臣與朱滔攻滄州，承嗣從父弟庭玠守之；

translations.literal: Baochen and Zhu Tao attacked Cang Prefecture; Chengsi's younger cousin Tingjie defended it;
translations.idiomatic: Baochen and Zhu Tao attacked Cang Prefecture, which Chengsi's younger cousin Tingjie was defending;

sentences.zh: 寶臣不能克。

translations.literal: Baochen could not capture it.
translations.idiomatic: Baochen could not capture it.

sentences.zh: 吐蕃寇涇州，涇原節度使馬璘破之於百里城。

translations.literal: Tibet raided Jing Prefecture; Ma Lin, military governor of Jingyuan, defeated them at Baili Fort.
translations.idiomatic: Tibet raided Jing Prefecture, and Ma Lin, military governor of Jingyuan, defeated them at Baili Fort.

sentences.zh: 戊午，命盧龍節度使朱泚出鎮奉天行營。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, Zhu Ci, military governor of Lulong, was ordered to leave his post and command the Fengtian field headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuwu, Zhu Ci, military governor of Lulong, was ordered to leave his post and take command of the Fengtian field headquarters.

sentences.zh: 冬，十月，辛酉朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the new moon of the day xinyou, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, in the tenth month, on the new moon of xinyou, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 盧子期攻磁州，城幾陷；

translations.literal: Lu Ziqi attacked Ci Prefecture, and the city nearly fell;
translations.idiomatic: Lu Ziqi attacked Ci Prefecture, and the city nearly fell;

sentences.zh: 李寶臣與昭義留後李承昭共救之，大破子期於清水，擒子期至京師；

translations.literal: Li Baochen and Li Chengzhao, acting governor of Zhaoyi, jointly rescued it, routed Ziqi utterly at Qingshui, seized Ziqi and brought him to the capital;
translations.idiomatic: Li Baochen and Li Chengzhao, acting governor of Zhaoyi, came to the rescue together, routed Ziqi at Qingshui, seized him, and brought him to the capital;

sentences.zh: 斬之。

translations.literal: He was beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: He was beheaded.

sentences.zh: 河南諸將又大破田悅於陳留；

translations.literal: The generals of Henan again routed Tian Yue at Chenliu;
translations.idiomatic: The generals of Henan again routed Tian Yue at Chenliu;

sentences.zh: 田承嗣懼。

translations.literal: Tian Chengsi grew afraid.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Chengsi grew afraid.

sentences.zh: 初，李正己遣使至魏州，承嗣囚之，至是，禮而遣之，遣使盡籍境內戶口、甲兵、谷帛之數以與之，曰：「承嗣今年八十有六，溘死無日，諸子不肖，悅亦孱弱，凡今日所有，為公守耳，豈足以辱公之師旅乎！」

translations.literal: Initially, Li Zhengji sent an envoy to Weizhou; Chengsi imprisoned him. Now he treated him with courtesy and sent him back, dispatching an envoy to register fully the numbers of households, armor and weapons, grain and cloth within his territory and give them to him, saying: "Chengsi is this year eighty-six; sudden death may come any day. My sons are unworthy, and Yue is also weak. All that I hold today I keep for you—how could it be enough to trouble your army!"
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Li Zhengji had sent an envoy to Weizhou, and Chengsi imprisoned him. Now he treated the envoy with courtesy and sent him back, dispatching another envoy to register fully the numbers of households, arms, grain, and cloth in his territory and deliver the record to Zhengji, saying, "Chengsi is eighty-six this year and may die at any moment. My sons are unworthy, and Yue is weak as well. All that I hold today I keep for you—how could it be worth troubling your army!"

sentences.zh: 立使者於廷，南向，拜而授書；

translations.literal: He had the envoy stand in the hall facing south, bowed, and handed over the letter;
translations.idiomatic: He had the envoy stand in the hall facing south, bowed, and handed over the letter;

sentences.zh: 又圖正己之像，焚香事之。

translations.literal: He also had a portrait made of Zhengji and burned incense before it in veneration.
translations.idiomatic: He also had a portrait made of Zhengji and burned incense before it in veneration.

sentences.zh: 正己悅，遂按兵不進。

translations.literal: Zhengji was pleased and thereupon held his troops and did not advance.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengji was pleased and held his troops back from advancing.

sentences.zh: 於是河南諸道兵皆不敢進。

translations.literal: Thereupon the troops of the Henan circuits all dared not advance.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the troops of the Henan circuits all dared not advance.

sentences.zh: 承嗣既無南顧之虞，得專意北方。

translations.literal: Chengsi, having no worry to look southward, was able to concentrate on the north.
translations.idiomatic: With no threat to worry about in the south, Chengsi was able to concentrate on the north.

sentences.zh: 上嘉李寶臣之功，遣中使馬承倩繼詔勞之；

translations.literal: The emperor praised Li Baochen's merit and sent palace envoy Ma Chengqian with an edict of commendation;
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised Li Baochen's achievements and sent palace envoy Ma Chengqian with an edict of commendation;

sentences.zh: 將還，寶臣詣其館，遣之百縑，承倩詬詈，擲出道中，寶臣慚其左右。

translations.literal: When about to return, Baochen went to his lodging and sent him a hundred bolts of silk; Chengqian cursed and abused him and threw them out into the road; Baochen was shamed before his attendants.
translations.idiomatic: When Chengqian was about to return, Baochen visited his lodging and sent him a hundred bolts of silk. Chengqian cursed and abused him and threw the gift out into the road, shaming Baochen before his attendants.

sentences.zh: 兵馬使王武俊說寶臣曰：「今公在軍中新立功，豎子尚爾，況寇平之後，以一幅詔書召歸闕下，一匹夫耳，不如釋承嗣，以為己資。」

translations.literal: Military commissioner Wang Wujun said to Baochen: "Now you have newly won merit in the army, yet this stripling treats you so—how much more after the rebels are pacified, when a single edict summons you back to court and you become a common man! Better to release Chengsi and use him as your resource."
translations.idiomatic: Military commissioner Wang Wujun said to Baochen, "You have just won fresh merit in the field, yet this stripling treats you so. After the rebels are pacified, a single edict will summon you back to court and reduce you to a common man. Better to release Chengsi and use him as your resource."

sentences.zh: 寶臣遂有玩寇之志。

translations.literal: Baochen thereupon harbored the intent to toy with the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Baochen thereupon harbored the intent to toy with the rebels.

sentences.zh: 承嗣知范陽寶臣鄉里，心常欲之，因刻石作讖云：「二帝同功勢萬全，將田為侶入幽燕。」

translations.literal: Chengsi knew that Fanyang was Baochen's native place and had long desired it; he therefore carved a stone prophecy saying: "Two emperors share merit and power in full completeness; taking Tian as companion, enter You and Yan."
translations.idiomatic: Chengsi knew that Fanyang was Baochen's native place and had long coveted it. He carved a stone prophecy that read, "Two emperors share merit and power in full completeness; taking Tian as companion, enter You and Yan."

sentences.zh: 密令瘞寶臣境內，使望氣者言彼有王氣，寶臣掘而得之。

translations.literal: He secretly had it buried within Baochen's territory and had a geomancer say that place had royal qi; Baochen dug and found it.
translations.idiomatic: He secretly had it buried within Baochen's territory and had a geomancer declare that the place had royal qi. Baochen dug and found it.

sentences.zh: 又令客說之曰：「公與朱滔共取滄州，得之，則地歸國，非公所有。

translations.literal: He also had a guest persuade him, saying: "You and Zhu Tao jointly take Cang Prefecture; if you get it, the land returns to the state—not yours to keep.
translations.idiomatic: He also had a guest persuade Baochen, saying, "You and Zhu Tao are jointly taking Cang Prefecture. If you capture it, the land returns to the state—not to you.

sentences.zh: 公能捨承嗣之罪，請以滄州歸公，仍願從公取范陽以自效。

translations.literal: If you can pardon Chengsi's guilt, I ask to give Cang Prefecture to you and still wish to follow you in taking Fanyang to prove my loyalty.
translations.idiomatic: If you can pardon Chengsi's guilt, I will give Cang Prefecture to you and follow you to take Fanyang in proof of my loyalty.

sentences.zh: 公以精騎前驅，承嗣以步卒繼之，蔑不克矣。」

translations.literal: You with elite cavalry in the vanguard and Chengsi with infantry following—nothing would fail to be captured."
translations.idiomatic: With your elite cavalry in the vanguard and Chengsi's infantry following, nothing would fail to fall."

sentences.zh: 寶臣喜，謂事合符讖，遂與承嗣通謀，密圖范陽，承嗣亦陳兵境上。

translations.literal: Baochen was pleased, thinking the matter matched the prophecy; he then conspired with Chengsi and secretly plotted Fanyang, while Chengsi also deployed troops on the border.
translations.idiomatic: Baochen was pleased, thinking the matter matched the prophecy. He then conspired with Chengsi and secretly plotted to take Fanyang, while Chengsi also deployed troops on the border.

sentences.zh: 寶臣謂滔使者曰：「聞朱公儀貌如神，願得畫像觀之。」

translations.literal: Baochen said to Tao's envoy: "I hear Lord Zhu's bearing is godlike; I wish to obtain a portrait to view."
translations.idiomatic: Baochen said to Tao's envoy, "I hear Lord Zhu's bearing is godlike. I would like to obtain a portrait to see."

sentences.zh: 滔與之。

translations.literal: Tao gave it to him.
translations.idiomatic: Tao sent him one.

sentences.zh: 寶臣置於射堂，與諸將共觀之，曰：「真神人也！」

translations.literal: Baochen placed it in the archery hall and viewed it together with the generals, saying: "Truly a god among men!"
translations.idiomatic: Baochen placed it in the archery hall and viewed it with his generals, saying, "Truly a god among men!"

sentences.zh: 滔軍於瓦橋，寶臣選精騎二千，通夜馳三百里襲之，戒曰：「取貌如射堂者。」

translations.literal: Tao was encamped at Waqiao; Baochen selected two thousand elite cavalry, rode three hundred li through the night to raid him, and warned: "Take the one who looks like the portrait in the archery hall."
translations.idiomatic: Tao was encamped at Waqiao. Baochen selected two thousand elite cavalry, rode three hundred li through the night to raid him, and ordered, "Capture the man who looks like the portrait in the archery hall."

sentences.zh: 時兩軍方睦，滔不虞有變，狼狽出戰而敗，會衣他服得免。

translations.literal: At the time the two armies were on friendly terms; Tao did not expect a change, fought in disarray and was defeated, but by chance wearing other clothes escaped.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the two armies were on friendly terms. Tao did not expect treachery, fought in disarray and was defeated, but escaped by chance because he was wearing other clothes.

sentences.zh: 寶臣欲乘勝取范陽，滔使雄武軍使昌平劉怦守留府。

translations.literal: Baochen wished to exploit the victory to take Fanyang; Tao had Liu Ping of Changping, commissioner of the Xiongwu Army, guard the headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: Baochen wished to exploit the victory to take Fanyang, but Tao had Xiongwu Army commissioner Liu Ping of Changping guard the headquarters.

sentences.zh: 寶臣知有備，不敢進。

translations.literal: Baochen knew there were preparations and dared not advance.
translations.idiomatic: Baochen saw that defenses were in place and dared not advance.

sentences.zh: 承嗣聞幽、恆兵交，即引軍南還，使謂寶臣曰：「河內有警，不暇從公，石上讖文，吾戲為之耳！」

translations.literal: Chengsi heard that the You and Heng armies were fighting, immediately led his troops southward back, and sent word to Baochen: "There is alarm in the interior; I have no leisure to follow you—the prophecy on the stone, I made it in jest!"
translations.idiomatic: When Chengsi heard that the You and Heng armies were fighting, he immediately led his troops back south and sent word to Baochen, "There is alarm in the interior and I have no leisure to follow you. The prophecy on the stone—I made it in jest!"

sentences.zh: 寶臣慚怒而退。

translations.literal: Baochen withdrew in shame and anger.
translations.idiomatic: Baochen withdrew in shame and anger.

sentences.zh: 寶臣既與朱滔有隙，以張孝忠為易州刺史，使將精騎七千以備之。

translations.literal: Baochen, having a rift with Zhu Tao, made Zhang Xiaozhong prefect of Yi and had him lead seven thousand elite cavalry to guard against him.
translations.idiomatic: Once Baochen had a rift with Zhu Tao, he appointed Zhang Xiaozhong prefect of Yi and had him lead seven thousand elite cavalry against him.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，貴妃獨孤氏薨，丁卯，追謚貞懿皇后。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, Consort Dugu died; on the day dingmao, she was posthumously given the title Empress Zhenyi.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingyin, Consort Dugu died. On the day dingmao, she was posthumously given the title Empress Zhenyi.

sentences.zh: 十一月，丁酉，田承嗣將吳希光以瀛州降。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day dingyou, Wu Xiguang, Chengsi's general, surrendered Ying Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the day dingyou, Wu Xiguang, Chengsi's general, surrendered Ying Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 嶺南節度使路嗣恭擢流人孟瑤、敬冕為將，討哥舒晃。

translations.literal: Lu Sigong, military governor of Lingnan, promoted the exiles Meng Yao and Jing Mian to generals to suppress Geshu Huang.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Sigong, military governor of Lingnan, promoted the exiles Meng Yao and Jing Mian to generals to suppress Geshu Huang.

sentences.zh: 瑤以大軍當其衝，冕自間道輕入，丁未，克廣州，斬哥舒晃及其黨萬餘人。

translations.literal: Yao with the main force blocked his front; Mian by a hidden path entered lightly; on the day dingwei, they captured Guang Prefecture, beheaded Geshu Huang and more than ten thousand of his followers.
translations.idiomatic: Yao blocked the enemy with the main force while Mian entered by a hidden path with light troops. On the day dingwei they captured Guang Prefecture and beheaded Geshu Huang and more than ten thousand of his followers.

sentences.zh: 嗣恭之討晃也，容管經略使王翃遣將將兵助之；

translations.literal: When Sigong was suppressing Huang, Wang Hong, frontier commissioner of Rongguan, dispatched a general with troops to assist;
translations.idiomatic: While Sigong was suppressing Huang, Wang Hong, frontier commissioner of Rongguan, dispatched a general with troops to assist;

sentences.zh: 西原賊帥覃問乘虛襲容州，翃伏兵擊擒之。

translations.literal: Tan Wen, bandit chief of Xiyuan, seized the opportunity to raid Rong Prefecture; Hong with ambush troops struck and captured him.
translations.idiomatic: Tan Wen, bandit chief of Xiyuan, seized the opportunity to raid Rong Prefecture, but Hong struck with ambush troops and captured him.

sentences.zh: 十二月，回紇千騎寇夏州，州將梁榮宗破之於烏水。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, a thousand Uighur cavalry raided Xia Prefecture; the prefectural general Liang Rongzong defeated them at Wushui.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, a thousand Uighur cavalry raided Xia Prefecture, and prefectural general Liang Rongzong defeated them at Wushui.

sentences.zh: 郭子儀遣兵三千救夏州，回紇遁去。

translations.literal: Guo Ziyi dispatched three thousand troops to rescue Xia Prefecture; the Uighurs fled.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Ziyi dispatched three thousand troops to rescue Xia Prefecture, and the Uighurs fled.

sentences.zh: 元載、王縉奏魏州鹽貴，請禁鹽入其境以困之。

translations.literal: Yuan Zai and Wang Jin memorialized that salt was expensive in Weizhou and requested prohibiting salt from entering its territory to distress them.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Zai and Wang Jin memorialized that salt was expensive in Weizhou and requested prohibiting salt from entering its territory to distress the rebels.

sentences.zh: 上不許，曰：「承嗣負朕，百姓何罪！」

translations.literal: The emperor did not permit it, saying: "Chengsi has wronged me—what crime have the common people committed!"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor refused, saying, "Chengsi has wronged me—what crime have the common people committed!"

sentences.zh: 田承嗣請入朝，李正己屢為之上表，乞許其自新。

translations.literal: Tian Chengsi requested to come to court; Li Zhengji repeatedly memorialized on his behalf, begging that he be allowed to reform.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Chengsi requested to come to court, and Li Zhengji repeatedly memorialized on his behalf, asking that he be allowed to reform.

sentences.zh: =代宗大曆十一年=

translations.literal: =Emperor Daizong, Eleventh Year of Dali=
translations.idiomatic: =The Eleventh Year of Dali of Emperor Daizong=

sentences.zh: 代宗睿文孝武皇帝中之下大曆十一年（

translations.literal: Mid-to-Lower of Emperor Daizong the Sage Filial Martial, Eleventh Year of Dali (
translations.idiomatic: The Eleventh Year of Dali of Emperor Daizong the Sage Filial Martial (mid-to-lower section) (

sentences.zh: 丙辰，公元七七六年）

translations.literal: bingchen, 776 CE)
translations.idiomatic: bingchen, 776 CE)

sentences.zh: 春，正月，壬辰，遣諫議大夫杜亞使魏州宣慰。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month, on the day renchen, Remonstrance Councilor Du Ya was sent to Weizhou to announce consolation.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, in the first month, on the day renchen, Remonstrance Councilor Du Ya was sent to Weizhou to announce imperial consolation.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，西川節度使崔寧奏破吐蕃四節度及突厥、吐谷渾、氐、羌群蠻眾二十餘萬，斬首萬餘級。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, Cui Ning, military governor of Xichuan, memorialized that he had defeated four Tibetan frontier commands and mixed hosts of Turks, Tuyuhun, Di, Qiang, and various tribes totaling more than two hundred thousand, beheading more than ten thousand.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinhai, Cui Ning, military governor of Xichuan, reported defeating four Tibetan frontier commands and mixed hosts of Turks, Tuyuhun, Di, Qiang, and various tribes totaling more than two hundred thousand, with more than ten thousand beheaded.

sentences.zh: 二月，庚辰，田承嗣復遣使上表，請入朝。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day gengchen, Tian Chengsi again sent envoys with a memorial requesting to come to court.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the day gengchen, Tian Chengsi again sent envoys with a memorial asking to come to court.

sentences.zh: 上乃下詔，赦承嗣罪，復其官爵，聽與家屬入朝，其所部拒朝命者，一切不問。

translations.literal: The emperor thereupon issued an edict pardoning Chengsi's crimes, restoring his office and rank, permitting him to come to court with his family; those under him who had resisted court orders—all would not be questioned.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor then issued an edict pardoning Chengsi's crimes, restoring his office and rank, and permitting him to come to court with his family. Those under him who had resisted court orders would not be questioned.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，增朔方五城戍兵，以備回紇。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, garrison troops of the five Shuofang cities were increased to guard against the Uighurs.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinsi, garrison troops at the five Shuofang cities were increased to guard against the Uighurs.

sentences.zh: 三月，戊子，河陽軍亂，逐監軍冉庭蘭出城，大掠三日。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day wuzi, the Heyang army mutinied, expelled army supervisor Yan Tinglan from the city, and plundered on a great scale for three days.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the day wuzi, the Heyang garrison mutinied, drove army supervisor Yan Tinglan out of the city, and looted for three days.

sentences.zh: 庭蘭成備而入，誅亂者數十人，乃定。

translations.literal: Tinglan made full preparations and entered, executed several dozen mutineers, and order was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Tinglan made full preparations and re-entered the city, executed several dozen mutineers, and order was restored.

sentences.zh: 五月，汴宋留後田神玉卒。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, Tian Shenyu, acting military governor of Biansong, died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Tian Shenyu, acting military governor of Biansong, died.

sentences.zh: 都虞候李靈曜殺兵馬使、濮州刺史孟鑒，北結田承嗣為援。

translations.literal: Chief adjutant Li Lingyao killed military commissioner and Pu Prefecture governor Meng Jian and allied with Tian Chengsi to the north for support.
translations.idiomatic: Chief adjutant Li Lingyao killed military commissioner and Pu Prefecture governor Meng Jian and allied with Tian Chengsi to the north for support.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以永平節度使李勉兼汴、宋等八州留後。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, Li Mian, military governor of Yongping, was additionally made acting governor of Bian, Song, and six other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guisi, Li Mian, military governor of Yongping, was additionally appointed acting governor of Bian, Song, and six other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以靈曜為濮州刺史，靈曜不受詔。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, Lingyao was made prefect of Pu; Lingyao did not accept the edict.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yiwei, Lingyao was appointed prefect of Pu, but Lingyao refused the edict.

sentences.zh: 六月，戊午，以靈曜為汴宋留後，遣使宣慰。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day wuwu, Lingyao was made acting military governor of Biansong, and envoys were sent to announce consolation.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the day wuwu, Lingyao was appointed acting military governor of Biansong, and envoys were sent to announce imperial consolation.

sentences.zh: 秋，七月，田承嗣遣兵寇滑州，敗李勉。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, Tian Chengsi dispatched troops to raid Hua Prefecture and defeated Li Mian.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the seventh month, Tian Chengsi sent troops to raid Hua Prefecture and defeated Li Mian.

sentences.zh: 吐蕃寇石門，入長澤川。

translations.literal: Tibet raided Shimen and entered Changze River valley.
translations.idiomatic: Tibet raided Shimen and entered the Changze River valley.

sentences.zh: 八月，丙寅，加盧龍節度使朱泚同平章事。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day bingyin, Zhu Ci, military governor of Lulong, was given the additional title of Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the day bingyin, Zhu Ci, military governor of Lulong, was given the additional title of Grand Councilor.

sentences.zh: 李靈曜既為留後，益驕慢，悉以其黨為管內八州刺史、縣令，欲效河北諸鎮。

translations.literal: Li Lingyao, having become acting governor, grew even more arrogant and insolent, appointing all his partisans as prefects and county magistrates of the eight prefectures under his jurisdiction, wishing to imitate the Hebei circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Once Lingyao became acting governor, he grew even more arrogant and insolent, appointing all his partisans as prefects and county magistrates of the eight prefectures under his jurisdiction, wishing to imitate the Hebei circuits.

sentences.zh: 甲申，詔淮西節度使李忠臣、永平節度使李勉、河陽三城使馬燧討之。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, an edict ordered Li Zhongchen, military governor of Huai-Xi, Li Mian, military governor of Yongping, and Ma Sui, commissioner of the Heyang Three Cities, to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiashen, an edict ordered Huai-Xi military governor Li Zhongchen, Yongping military governor Li Mian, and Heyang Three Cities commissioner Ma Sui to suppress him.

sentences.zh: 淮南節度使陳少游、淄青節度使李正己皆進兵擊靈曜。

translations.literal: Chen Shaoyou, military governor of Huainan, and Li Zhengji, military governor of Ziqing, both advanced troops to attack Lingyao.
translations.idiomatic: Huainan military governor Chen Shaoyou and Ziqing military governor Li Zhengji both advanced troops to attack Lingyao.

sentences.zh: 汴宋兵馬使、攝節度副使李僧惠，靈曜之謀主也。

translations.literal: Li Senghui, Biansong military commissioner and acting deputy military governor, was Lingyao's chief strategist.
translations.idiomatic: Li Senghui, Biansong military commissioner and acting deputy military governor, was Lingyao's chief strategist.

sentences.zh: 宋州牙門將劉昌遣曾神表潛說僧惠；

translations.literal: Liu Chang, gate guard general of Song Prefecture, sent Zeng Shenbiao secretly to persuade Senghui;
translations.idiomatic: Liu Chang, gate guard general of Song Prefecture, sent Zeng Shenbiao secretly to persuade Senghui;

sentences.zh: 僧惠召問計，昌為之泣陳逆順。

translations.literal: Senghui summoned him to ask his plan; Chang wept as he set forth the difference between rebellion and loyalty.
translations.idiomatic: Senghui summoned him to ask his plan, and Chang wept as he set forth the difference between rebellion and loyalty.

sentences.zh: 僧惠乃與汴宋牙將高憑、石隱金遣神表奉表詣京師，請討靈曜。

translations.literal: Senghui then together with Biansong gate generals Gao Ping and Shi Yinjian sent Shenbiao with a memorial to the capital requesting to suppress Lingyao.
translations.idiomatic: Senghui then joined with Biansong gate generals Gao Ping and Shi Yinjian to send Shenbiao to the capital with a memorial requesting permission to suppress Lingyao.

sentences.zh: 九月，壬戌，以僧惠為宋州刺史，憑為曹州刺史，隱金為鄆州刺史。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day renxu, Senghui was made prefect of Song, Ping prefect of Cao, and Yinjian prefect of Yan.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the day renxu, Senghui was appointed prefect of Song, Ping prefect of Cao, and Yinjian prefect of Yan.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，李忠臣、馬燧軍於鄭州，靈曜引兵逆戰；

translations.literal: On the day yichou, Li Zhongchen and Ma Sui encamped at Zheng Prefecture; Lingyao led troops to oppose them in battle;
translations.idiomatic: On the day yichou, Li Zhongchen and Ma Sui encamped at Zheng Prefecture, and Lingyao led troops to oppose them;

sentences.zh: 兩軍不意其至，退軍滎澤，淮西軍士潰去者什五六。

translations.literal: Both armies did not expect his arrival, withdrew to Xingze, and five or six tenths of the Huai-Xi soldiers dispersed.
translations.idiomatic: Both armies did not expect his arrival, withdrew to Xingze, and five or six tenths of the Huai-Xi soldiers deserted.

sentences.zh: 鄭州士民皆驚，走入東都。

translations.literal: The people of Zheng Prefecture were all alarmed and fled into the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Zheng Prefecture were alarmed and fled into the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 忠臣將歸淮西，燧固執不可，曰：「以順討逆，何憂不克？

translations.literal: Zhongchen was about to return to Huai-Xi; Sui firmly objected and would not allow it, saying: "Using loyalty to suppress rebellion—why worry about not succeeding?
translations.idiomatic: Zhongchen was about to return to Huai-Xi, but Sui firmly objected, saying, "We are using loyalty to suppress rebellion—why worry about not succeeding?

sentences.zh: 奈何自棄功名！」

translations.literal: How can you abandon your merit and fame!"
translations.idiomatic: How can you throw away your merit and fame!"

sentences.zh: 堅壁不動。

translations.literal: He held the walls firm and did not move.
translations.idiomatic: He held firm behind the walls and did not move.

sentences.zh: 忠臣聞之，稍收散卒，數日皆集，軍勢復振。

translations.literal: Zhongchen heard of it, gradually gathered the scattered soldiers, and within several days all assembled; military momentum revived.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhongchen heard this, he gradually gathered the scattered soldiers, and within several days all had reassembled and military momentum revived.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，李正己奏克鄆、濮二州。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, Li Zhengji memorialized that he had captured Yan and Pu prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuchen, Li Zhengji reported capturing Yan and Pu prefectures.

sentences.zh: 壬申，李僧惠敗靈曜兵於雍丘。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, Li Senghui defeated Lingyao's troops at Yongqiu.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renshen, Li Senghui defeated Lingyao's troops at Yongqiu.

sentences.zh: 冬，十月，李忠臣、馬燧進擊靈曜，忠臣行汴南，燧行汴北，屢破靈曜兵；

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, Li Zhongchen and Ma Sui advanced to attack Lingyao; Zhongchen marched on the south of Bian, Sui on the north of Bian, repeatedly defeating Lingyao's troops;
translations.idiomatic: In winter, in the tenth month, Li Zhongchen and Ma Sui advanced against Lingyao. Zhongchen marched south of Bian while Sui marched north of Bian, repeatedly defeating Lingyao's troops;

sentences.zh: 壬寅，與陳少游前軍合，與靈曜大戰於汴州城西，靈曜敗，入城固守。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, they joined Chen Shaoyou's vanguard and fought a great battle with Lingyao west of Bian Prefecture city; Lingyao was defeated and entered the city to hold firm.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renyin they joined Chen Shaoyou's vanguard and fought a great battle with Lingyao west of Bian Prefecture city. Lingyao was defeated and retreated into the city to hold out.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，忠臣等圍之。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, Zhongchen and the others besieged it.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guimao, Zhongchen and the others besieged the city.

sentences.zh: 田承嗣遣田悅將兵救靈曜，敗永平、淄青兵於匡城，乘勝進軍汴州，乙巳，營於城北數里。

translations.literal: Tian Chengsi dispatched Tian Yue with troops to rescue Lingyao, defeated Yongping and Ziqing troops at Kuangcheng, exploited the victory to advance on Bian Prefecture, and on the day yisi encamped several li north of the city.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Chengsi sent Tian Yue with troops to rescue Lingyao. Yue defeated Yongping and Ziqing troops at Kuangcheng, exploited the victory to advance on Bian Prefecture, and on the day yisi encamped several li north of the city.

sentences.zh: 丙午，忠臣遣裨將李重倩將輕騎數百夜入其營，縱橫貫穿，斬數十人而還，營中大駭；

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, Zhongchen dispatched subordinate general Li Zhongqian with several hundred light cavalry to enter their camp by night, cut through back and forth, beheaded several dozen men and returned; the camp was greatly alarmed;
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingwu, Zhongchen dispatched subordinate general Li Zhongqian with several hundred light cavalry to raid their camp by night, cut through back and forth, beheaded several dozen men, and returned. The camp was thrown into great alarm;

sentences.zh: 忠臣、燧因以大軍乘之，鼓噪而入，悅眾不戰而潰，悅脫身北走，將士死者相枕藉，不可勝數。

translations.literal: Zhongchen and Sui thereupon with the main force exploited the opportunity, entered with drums and shouts; Yue's host fled without fighting, Yue escaped northward alone, and officers and soldiers dead lay piled one upon another beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongchen and Sui then struck with the main force, entering with drums and shouts. Yue's host fled without fighting, Yue escaped northward alone, and dead officers and soldiers lay piled one upon another beyond counting.

sentences.zh: 靈曜聞之，開門夜遁，汴州平。

translations.literal: Lingyao heard of it, opened the gates and fled by night; Bian Prefecture was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: When Lingyao heard of this, he opened the gates and fled by night. Bian Prefecture was pacified.

sentences.zh: 重倩，本奚也。

translations.literal: Zhongqian was originally a Xi tribesman.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongqian was originally a Xi tribesman.

sentences.zh: 丁未，靈曜至韋城，永平將杜如江擒之。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, Lingyao reached Weicheng; Yongping general Du Rujiang captured him.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingwei, Lingyao reached Weicheng, where Yongping general Du Rujiang captured him.

sentences.zh: 燧知忠臣暴戾，以己功讓之，不入汴城，引軍西屯板橋。

translations.literal: Sui knew Zhongchen was violent and tyrannical, yielded his own merit to him, did not enter Bian city, and led his army west to encamp at Banqiao.
translations.idiomatic: Sui knew Zhongchen was violent and tyrannical, yielded his own merit to him, did not enter Bian city, and led his army west to encamp at Banqiao.

sentences.zh: 忠臣入城，果專其功；

translations.literal: Zhongchen entered the city and indeed monopolized the credit;
translations.idiomatic: Zhongchen entered the city and indeed monopolized the credit;

sentences.zh: 宋州刺史李僧惠與之爭功，忠臣因會擊殺之；

translations.literal: Song Prefecture Prefect Li Shenghui contested credit with him; Zhongchen took advantage of a meeting and struck and killed him;
translations.idiomatic: Song Prefecture Prefect Li Shenghui contested credit with him; Zhongchen took advantage of a meeting and killed him;

sentences.zh: 又欲殺劉昌，昌遁逃得免。

translations.literal: He also wished to kill Liu Chang; Chang fled and escaped.
translations.idiomatic: He also wished to kill Liu Chang; Chang fled and escaped.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，李勉械送李靈曜至京師；

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, Li Mian sent Li Lingyao to the capital in shackles;
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiayin, Li Mian sent Li Lingyao to the capital in shackles;

sentences.zh: 斬之。

translations.literal: He was beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: He was beheaded.

sentences.zh: 十二月，丁亥，李正己、李寶臣並加同平章事。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day dinghai, Li Zhengyi and Li Baochen were both promoted to Co-Rank Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the day dinghai, Li Zhengyi and Li Baochen were both promoted to Co-Rank Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 涇原節度使馬璘疾亟，以行軍司馬段秀實知節度事，付以後事。

translations.literal: Ma Lin, military governor of Jingyuan Circuit, was gravely ill; he put Acting Commissioner Duan Xiushi in charge of circuit affairs and entrusted him with subsequent matters.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Lin, military governor of Jingyuan Circuit, was gravely ill; he put Acting Commissioner Duan Xiushi in charge of circuit affairs and entrusted him with all subsequent matters.

sentences.zh: 秀實嚴兵以備非常，丙申，璘薨，軍中奔哭者數千人。

translations.literal: Xiushi tightened the troops to guard against the unexpected. On the day bingshen, Lin died; several thousand in the army ran to weep.
translations.idiomatic: Xiushi tightened military discipline to guard against the unexpected. On the day bingshen, Lin died, and several thousand soldiers ran to weep.

sentences.zh: 喧咽門屏，秀實悉不聽入。

translations.literal: The clamor filled the gates and screens; Xiushi would not let any of them enter.
translations.idiomatic: The clamor filled the gates and barriers; Xiushi would not let any of them enter.

sentences.zh: 命押牙馬□治喪事於內，李漢惠接賓客於外，妻妾子孫位於堂，宗族位於庭，將佐位於前，牙士卒哭於營伍，百姓各守其家。

translations.literal: He ordered the adjutant Ma [character missing] to manage funeral affairs within; Li Hanhui received guests without; wives, concubines, and descendants took their places in the hall, clansmen in the courtyard, officers and aides in front, yabing soldiers wept in their companies, and commoners each kept to their homes.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Adjutant Ma Di to manage funeral affairs within; Li Hanhui received guests without; wives, concubines, and descendants took their places in the hall, clansmen in the courtyard, officers and aides in front, headquarters soldiers wept in their companies, and commoners each kept to their homes.

sentences.zh: 有離立偶語於衢路，輒執而囚之；

translations.literal: Those who stood apart and whispered together in the thoroughfares were immediately seized and imprisoned;
translations.idiomatic: Anyone who stood apart and whispered together in the streets was immediately seized and imprisoned;

sentences.zh: 非護喪從行者無得遠送。

translations.literal: Those not in the funeral escort were not permitted to go far to see the coffin off.
translations.idiomatic: Those not in the funeral escort were not permitted to go far to see the coffin off.

sentences.zh: 致祭拜哭，皆有儀節，送喪近遠，皆有定處，違者以軍法從事。

translations.literal: Offerings, bows, and wailing all had prescribed rites; near and far for seeing the coffin off each had fixed places; violators were dealt with by military law.
translations.idiomatic: Offerings, bows, and wailing all followed prescribed rites; places for escorting the coffin, near and far, were all fixed; violators were dealt with under military law.

sentences.zh: 都虞候史廷幹、兵馬使崔珍、十將張景華謀因喪作亂，秀實知之，奏廷幹入宿衛，徙珍屯靈台，補景華外職，不戮一人，軍府晏然。

translations.literal: Chief Adjutant Shi Tinggan, Cavalry Commissioner Cui Zhen, and Company Officer Zhang Jinghua plotted to use the funeral to raise a disturbance; Xiushi learned of it, memorialized to have Tinggan enter palace guard service, transferred Zhen to encamp at Lingtai, assigned Jinghua to an outside post, executed not a single man, and the army headquarters remained tranquil.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Adjutant Shi Tinggan, Cavalry Commissioner Cui Zhen, and Company Officer Zhang Jinghua plotted to use the funeral to raise a disturbance; Xiushi learned of it, had Tinggan transferred to palace guard service, moved Zhen to encamp at Lingtai, assigned Jinghua to an outside post, executed not a single man, and the army headquarters remained tranquil.

sentences.zh: 璘家富有無算，治第京師，甲於勳貴，中堂費二十萬緡，他室所減無幾，其子孫無行，家資尋盡。

translations.literal: Lin's household was wealthy beyond reckoning; he built a mansion in the capital surpassing the meritorious nobles; the central hall alone cost two hundred thousand strings of cash, and the other rooms were diminished only slightly; his descendants were dissolute, and the family fortune was soon exhausted.
translations.idiomatic: Lin's household was fabulously wealthy beyond reckoning; he built a mansion in the capital surpassing the meritorious nobles; the central hall alone cost two hundred thousand strings of cash, and the other rooms cost scarcely less; his descendants were dissolute, and the family fortune was soon exhausted.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，昭義節度使李承昭表稱疾篤，以澤潞行軍司馬李抱真兼知磁、邢兩州留後。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, Li Chengshao, military governor of Zhaoyi Circuit, memorialized that he was gravely ill and had Li Baozhen, acting commissioner of Ze-Lu, also take charge as acting prefect of Ci and Xing prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuxu, Li Chengshao, military governor of Zhaoyi Circuit, memorialized that he was gravely ill and had Li Baozhen, acting commissioner of Ze-Lu, also take charge as acting prefect of Ci and Xing prefectures.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，加淮西節度使李忠臣同平章事，仍領汴州刺史，徙治汴州。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, Li Zhongchen, military governor of Huaixi Circuit, was promoted to Co-Rank Director; he still held the post of Bian Prefecture prefect and moved his headquarters to Bian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengxu, Li Zhongchen, military governor of Huaixi Circuit, was promoted to Co-Rank Director; he still held the post of Bian Prefecture prefect and moved his headquarters to Bian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: =代宗大曆十二年=

translations.literal: =Emperor Daizong, Twelfth Year of Dali=
translations.idiomatic: =The Twelfth Year of Dali of Emperor Daizong=

sentences.zh: 代宗睿文孝武皇帝中之下大曆十二年（

translations.literal: Mid-to-Lower of Emperor Daizong the Sage Filial Martial, Twelfth Year of Dali (
translations.idiomatic: The Twelfth Year of Dali of Emperor Daizong the Sage Filial Martial (mid-to-lower section) (

sentences.zh: 丁巳，公元七七七年）

translations.literal: dingsi, 777 CE)
translations.idiomatic: dingsi, 777 CE)

sentences.zh: 春，三月，乙卯，兵部尚書、同平章事、鳳翔、懷澤潞、秦隴節度使李抱玉薨，弟抱真仍領懷澤潞留後。

translations.literal: In spring, the third month, on the day yimao, Li Baoyu, Minister of War, Co-Rank Director, and military governor of Fengxiang, Huai-Ze-Lu, and Qin-Long circuits, died; his younger brother Baozhen continued to hold the Huai-Ze-Lu acting commission.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, in the third month, on the day yimao, Li Baoyu, Minister of War, Co-Rank Director, and military governor of Fengxiang, Huai-Ze-Lu, and Qin-Long circuits, died; his younger brother Baozhen continued to hold the Huai-Ze-Lu acting commission.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以河東行軍司馬鮑防為河東節度使。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, Bao Fang, acting commissioner of Hedong, was appointed military governor of Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guihai, Bao Fang, acting commissioner of Hedong, was appointed military governor of Hedong.

sentences.zh: 防，襄州人也。

translations.literal: Fang was a man of Xiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Fang was a native of Xiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 田承嗣竟不入朝，又助李靈曜，上覆命討之。

translations.literal: Tian Chengsi after all did not enter court, and again aided Li Lingyao; the emperor reversed his command and ordered an attack on him.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Chengsi still did not come to court after all, and again aided Li Lingyao; the emperor reversed his earlier order and commanded an attack on him.

sentences.zh: 承嗣乃復上表謝罪。

translations.literal: Chengshi thereupon submitted another memorial apologizing.
translations.idiomatic: Chengshi thereupon submitted another memorial of apology.

sentences.zh: 上亦無如之何，庚午，悉復承嗣官爵，仍令不必入朝。

translations.literal: The emperor could do nothing about it; on the day gengwu he fully restored Chengsi's offices and titles and further ordered that he need not enter court.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor could do nothing about it; on the day gengwu he fully restored Chengsi's offices and titles and further ordered that he need not come to court.

sentences.zh: 中書侍郎、同平章事元載專橫，黃門侍郎、同平章事王縉附之，二人俱貪。

translations.literal: Vice Director of the Secretariat Yuan Zai was domineering; Vice Director of the Chancellery Wang Jin attached himself to Zai, and both were greedy.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Director of the Secretariat Yuan Zai was domineering; Vice Director of the Chancellery Wang Jin attached himself to Zai, and both were greedy.

sentences.zh: 載妻王氏及子伯和、仲武，縉弟、妹及尼出入者，爭納賄賂。

translations.literal: Zai's wife Lady Wang and sons Bohe and Zhongwu, Jin's younger brother, younger sister, and the nuns who came and went all vied to accept bribes.
translations.idiomatic: Zai's wife Lady Wang and sons Bohe and Zhongwu, Jin's younger brother, younger sister, and the nuns who came and went all vied to accept bribes.

sentences.zh: 又以政事委群吏，士之求進者，不結其子弟及主書卓英倩等，無由自達。

translations.literal: They also entrusted governmental affairs to the clerks; gentlemen seeking advancement who did not cultivate their sons and younger relatives and Chief Clerk Zhuo Yingqian and the like had no means to reach the throne themselves.
translations.idiomatic: They also entrusted governmental affairs to clerks; gentlemen seeking advancement who did not cultivate their sons, younger relatives, and Chief Clerk Zhuo Yingqian and the like had no way to reach the throne on their own.

sentences.zh: 上含容累年，載、縉不悛。

translations.literal: The emperor tolerated them for many years; Zai and Jin did not repent.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor tolerated them for many years, but Zai and Jin did not repent.

sentences.zh: 上欲誅之，恐左右漏洩，無可與言者，獨與左金吾大將軍吳湊謀之。

translations.literal: The emperor wished to execute them but feared leaks from those around him and had no one with whom to speak; he alone plotted with Wu Cou, General of the Left Golden Guard.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor wished to execute them but feared leaks from those around him and had no one with whom to speak; he plotted with Wu Cou, General of the Left Golden Guard, alone.

sentences.zh: 湊，上之舅也。

translations.literal: Cou was the emperor's maternal uncle.
translations.idiomatic: Cou was the emperor's maternal uncle.

sentences.zh: 會有告載、縉夜醮圖為不軌者，庚辰，上御延英殿，命湊收載、縉於政事堂，又收仲武及卓英倩等繫獄。

translations.literal: It happened that someone reported Zai and Jin performing night rituals plotting treason; on the day gengchen the emperor attended at Yanying Hall, ordered Cou to seize Zai and Jin at the Hall of Administration Affairs, and also seized Zhongwu and Zhuo Yingqian and the rest and imprisoned them.
translations.idiomatic: It happened that someone reported Zai and Jin performing night rituals and plotting treason; on the day gengchen the emperor attended at Yanying Hall, ordered Cou to seize Zai and Jin at the Hall of Administration Affairs, and also seized Zhongwu, Zhuo Yingqian, and the rest and imprisoned them.

sentences.zh: 命吏部尚書劉晏與御史大夫李涵等同鞫之，問端皆出禁中，仍遣中使詰以陰事，載、縉皆伏罪。

translations.literal: He ordered Minister of Personnel Liu Yan and Censor-in-Chief Li Han and others jointly to interrogate them; the points of inquiry all came from within the palace, and palace envoys were still sent to question them on secret matters; Zai and Jin both confessed guilt.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Minister of Personnel Liu Yan and Censor-in-Chief Li Han and others jointly to interrogate them; the points of inquiry all came from within the palace, and palace envoys were still sent to question them on secret matters; Zai and Jin both confessed guilt.

sentences.zh: 是日，先杖殺左衛將軍、知內侍省事董秀於禁中，乃賜載自盡於萬年縣。

translations.literal: That day, Left Guard General and Director of Palace Domestic Service Dong Xiu was first beaten to death within the palace; then Zai was granted suicide in Wannian County.
translations.idiomatic: That day, Left Guard General and Director of Palace Domestic Service Dong Xiu was first beaten to death within the palace; then Zai was granted suicide in Wannian County.

sentences.zh: 載請主者：「願得快死！」

translations.literal: Zai asked the attendant: 「I wish to die quickly!
translations.idiomatic: Zai asked the attendant: 「I wish to die quickly!

sentences.zh: 主者曰：「相公須受少污辱，勿怪！」

translations.literal: 」The attendant said: 「The Chancellor must suffer a little humiliation—do not take offense!
translations.idiomatic: 」The attendant said: 「The chancellor must suffer a little humiliation—do not take offense!

sentences.zh: 乃脫穢襪塞其口而殺之。

translations.literal: 」He then removed foul socks, stuffed his mouth with them, and killed him.
translations.idiomatic: 」He then removed foul socks, stuffed his mouth with them, and killed him.

sentences.zh: 王縉初亦賜自盡，劉晏謂李涵等曰：「故事，重刑覆奏，況大臣乎！
